title: 3.1 Greetings and Names
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Recognize and use three greetings/closings plus the fixed name question and answer chunks.
grammar_function: My and your are learned only inside fixed name chunks; possessive substitution is not tested until 3.7.
prerequisite: Unit 1 identity questions and Unit 2 text/audio choice routines.
speaking_outcome: Repeat a greeting, ask What is your name?, answer with a scenario name, and close with Goodbye.

cards.pedagogy_note: introduces morning greeting with time cue
